_notes: Externalized expectations for the Reports module.
country_map: logged-in client workspace/country name -> code shown in report metadata.
report_columns: exact column headers, IN ORDER, per report type label as it appears in the Select Report dropdown.
Leave a report_columns list EMPTY to fall back to a non-empty presence check until the
authoritative column set is confirmed with the product team (see Open Question #2).
Entity is a MULTISELECT: the default 'All' is not committed until the dropdown is opened
and 'All' is clicked, after which the field displays 'N of N selected' (e.g. '211 of 211
selected') and Generate becomes enabled once a date range is also provided.
report_config: per-type generate inputs. date_mode 'range' fills From/To; 'single' fills
the Date field. platform_required types default the Submission Platform to GTES.
The report opens in a NEW WINDOW rendered from a generic vatdtai-report-* template;
meta formats: 'Country: BE | Entity: All', 'Date Range: MM/DD/YYYY to MM/DD/YYYY',
output_format: 'table' reports render table.vatdtai-report-table with report_columns;
and add 'Platform: <GTES|Pagero>' to the meta line.
